## `metrics.log`

A time-series log of daily build activity. One line per calendar day. Read nightly by reporting jobs.

### Columns / Fields

| # | Field | Type | Description |

| 3 | `builds` | `integer` | Total number of builds triggered on that date. |
| 4 | `failures` | `integer` | Number of builds that failed on that date. |
